# pve_permissions (Data Source)

Retrieves effective permissions (`GET /access/permissions`). The API's nested map (path → privilege → propagate flag) is flattened into `entries`, one row per path/privilege pair, sorted by path then privilege for stable output.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_permissions" "ops" {
  userid = "ops@pam"
}

output "ops_permissions" {
  value = data.pve_permissions.ops.entries
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `path` (String) Only dump this specific path, not the whole tree.
- `userid` (String) User ID or full API token ID whose permissions to dump. Defaults to the credentials' own subject; dumping another user requires `Sys.Audit` on `/access`.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Flattened permission rows, sorted by path then privilege. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Static identifier for the permissions dump.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) Access control path the privilege is effective on.
- `privilege` (String) Privilege (role) name, e.g. `Administrator`.
- `propagate` (Boolean) Whether the privilege propagates from this path to child paths.
